newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Albacom sees accord with ENI close.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Albacom sees accord with ENI close.

text.p: Italy's energy giant ENI is not about to pull out of talks on an accord with Albacom, and in fact an agreement is very close, said the managing director of one of Albacom's partners, Davide Croff of banking group BNL.
He was responding to a newspaper report that ENI and Albacom were a long way from reaching an agreement.
Croff was speaking while attending a conference about the telecoms joint venture Albacom, which includes state-controlled bank BNL, TV and advertising group Mediaset and British Telecommunications.
"It don't see why (ENI) would want to pull out. We have no indication that this is what they want," said Croff. He added that "we are close, very close" to an understanding.
